summary: Staged privilege escalation and hardware provisioning for new SRE (hybrid role)
description:
Issue summary:
A new hire (Liam Ortega) joining SRE on 2026-03-15 will have a hybrid role (SRE + infra support for Dedicated). We need staged access: immediate low-privilege accounts for ramp-up, mid-term monitoring and incident access, and long-term write privileges after training and manager sign-off. Also request company laptop and 2-factor hardware.

Impact:
Without staged access the new hire cannot complete onboarding checklists, shadow on-call, or validate Dedicated autoscaling tests. Delays will push ramp to full duty past the planned 90-day window.

Environment:
Onboarding for prod and staging infrastructure in us-east region. This will touch AWS accounts (redwood-prod, redwood-dedicated-prod), Vault policies, Datadog, PagerDuty, and internal jump hosts.

Requested access (staged):
- Day 0 (read-only): AWS read-only on redwood-prod and redwood-dedicated-prod, Datadog viewer, GitHub repo access to infra repos (read), Confluence onboarding pages.
- After training sign-offs (approx week 4): monitoring write on Datadog (dashboards), PagerDuty read/write for on-call shadowing, limited SSH to staging jump host (bastion), Vault read for non-production secrets.
- After 90 days / manager approval: IAM role to assume SRE-operator for production ops, ability to access KMS decrypt for maintenance ops on Dedicated, permission to trigger rollout jobs in the serving-runtime CI.

Hardware and security:
- Company laptop (MacBook Pro 14) with standard SRE image.
- YubiKey for 2FA and emergency access.
- Enrollment in company device management (Jamf).

Timeline and constraints:
- New hire start date: 2026-03-15. Low-priv access should be available on Day 0.
- Mid-stage escalation window: 2026-04-12 after onboarding training completed.
- Full escalation after manager (Priya Singh) confirms training and security review, no earlier than 2026-06-13.

Policy question:
Does Redwood have a formal policy for staggered privilege handoff with documented sign-offs for hybrid roles? If not, can we rely on the ad-hoc checklist in Confluence? Request clarification so HR/Security know which artifacts to collect for audit purposes.
requested_access: Datadog: Viewer Day0, Write after week 4
GitHub infra repos: read Day0, write after 90d
Vault: read non-prod Day0, prod read after 90d as approved
SSH: staging jump host (restricted CIDR) after week 4
requested_timeline: Day0 access ready 2026-03-15; mid-stage escalation ~2026-04-12; full escalation earliest 2026-06-13 after manager sign-off
comments: 2026-03-10 - Maya Chen: Opening ticket - onboarding coordinator Priya Singh confirmed start date and training schedule. Requested staged approach to limit blast radius while allowing shadowing.
2026-03-10 - Raj Patel: Assigned. Will coordinate with Hardware Ops for laptop and Security for YubiKey. IAM team to prepare temp read-only roles. ETA for Day0 provisioning: 2026-03-14.
2026-03-11 - Security (Elena Martinez): FYI — we'll need signed AUP + training completion record before granting Vault production access. Please add user to security-training queue.
2026-03-11 - Hardware Ops (Samir Khan): Laptop ordered via hardware portal (order #HW-12984). Estimated delivery 2026-03-14. Will enroll in Jamf once imaged.
2026-03-12 - Raj Patel: Created read-only roles and requested Datadog viewer group addition. Pushed for YubiKey order; Security approved expedited shipping.
2026-03-12 - Priya Singh (manager): Noted. Will perform week-4 training sign-off in Confluence page and notify security. Also asked about a canonical sign-off checklist — linking below.
2026-03-12 - Maya Chen: Added links to Confluence onboarding checklist and training schedule in the investigation notes.
2026-03-12 - Raj Patel: Leaving next steps for follow-up: confirm laptop receipt and validate Day0 access by 2026-03-15 morning PST.
investigation_notes: Checked existing onboarding runbook: https://redwood-confluence.internal/onboarding/sre-rolling-access (contains ad-hoc checklist but not formal policy sign-off template).
IAM: prepared role redwood-onboarding-readonly (scoped to tagging convention 'onboarded:liam_ortega') to limit permissions. Will be time-limited token with expiry 90 days unless escalated.
Datadog: created group 'sre-onboard-viewers' and scheduled membership; dashboards filtered by team tags. Need PR to infra-config to grant write role at escalation time (see related_github_prs).
Vault: policy redwood-onboard-nonprod created. Production Vault access requires Security approval and signed training evidence (per security team).
Networking: staging jump host allowed only from office static IP and new hire home CIDR if requested. Recommend office-first access for initial period.
Risk: Hybrid SRE role interacts with Dedicated capacity pools; recommend two-step approval (manager + security) before granting KMS decrypt or operator role.
Slack refs: #onboarding, #sre-oncall, #security - created short thread to surface any objections.
resolution: Workaround implemented: Day0 read-only roles, Datadog viewer membership, GitHub read access, and laptop order completed. YubiKey expedited. Full escalation pending: manager training sign-off and security evidence. Next steps: Security to confirm receipt of signed AUP and training completion, IAM to schedule timed role swap on approved date.
